fact: On 2 November 2026 a Ministry of Social Solidarity official told a parliamentary committee that the ministry uses network linkage with government bodies, including the Interior Ministry, to check applicants' vehicle ownership, commercial activity and tax cards when verifying Takaful and Karama eligibility.
title: ممثل الحكومة لـ«النواب»: الربط الشبكي يحكم التحقق من بيانات مستفيدي «تكافل وكرامة»
